title: 岩爆監測與卸壓支護~Rockburst monitoring and pressure-relief support
focus: 用能量、變形與監測不確定度辨識岩爆支護需求~Assess rockburst support using energy, deformation and monitoring uncertainty
summary: 本課以用能量、變形與監測不確定度辨識岩爆支護需求為主線，從彈性能與釋放比例與拋出物動能與速度建立系統邊界，再把動態載入速率與試驗邊界、串聯力鏈與容量區分連到事件後剩餘行程與復核。靜態強度、動態吸能及事件預警是不同證據，不可互相替代。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。~This course focuses on assess rockburst support using energy, deformation and monitoring uncertainty. It begins with Elastic energy and releasable fraction and Ejected-rock energy and velocity, links Dynamic rate and test boundaries and Serial force paths and capacity distinctions, and ends with Post-event remaining stroke and requalification. Static strength, dynamic energy absorption and event warning are distinct evidence and are not interchangeable. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.

units.anchor: 彈性能與釋放比例~Elastic energy and releasable fraction
units.title: 彈性能與釋放比例~Elastic energy and releasable fraction
units.mechanism: 高應力岩體儲存彈性能，開挖造成應力重分配後可能釋放其中一部分。線彈性能密度只是儲存量的理想估計，還需區分裂縫生成、摩擦、波動和拋出物能量；把全部體積乘能量密度直接當支護需求會忽略真正耦合路徑。 判別這個機制時，應觀察對照應力估計、岩體剛度及事件後破裂與拋出證據；若出現把儲存能全部或完全不計入支護需求，都可能誤判作用，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Stressed rock stores elastic energy, part of which may be released after excavation redistributes stress. Elastic density estimates storage rather than its partition into fracture, friction, waves and ejection. Multiplying volume by density does not establish support demand without the coupling pathway and releasable fraction. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare stress estimates and rock stiffness with post-event fracture and ejection evidence. If equating stored energy to demand, or ignoring it entirely, misrepresents the action, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：u=sigma^2/(2E)=(100 MPa)^2/(2*50000 MPa)=0.10 MPa=100 kJ/m3。靜態強度、動態吸能及事件預警是不同證據，不可互相替代。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: u=sigma^2/(2E)=(100 MPa)^2/(2*50000 MPa)=0.10 MPa=100 kJ/m3. Static strength, dynamic energy absorption and event warning are distinct evidence and are not interchangeable. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare stress estimates and rock stiffness with post-event fracture and ejection evidence to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If equating stored energy to demand, or ignoring it entirely, misrepresents the action, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

units.anchor: 拋出物動能與速度~Ejected-rock energy and velocity
units.title: 拋出物動能與速度~Ejected-rock energy and velocity
units.mechanism: 拋出物的動能與速度平方成正比，重量估計和速度估計的誤差有不同影響。表面落塊不一定由同一動態機制造成，需區分重力落下與應力驅動拋出；單塊估算也不能代表整個事件作用在支護的時間和空間分布。 判別這個機制時，應觀察用可取得的影像、塊體質量及落點證據約束速度範圍；若出現僅憑落塊尺寸推估動態需求而漏掉速度平方效應，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Ejection energy varies with velocity squared, making mass and velocity uncertainty affect it differently. Surface falls need not share the same dynamic mechanism; distinguish gravity fall from stress-driven ejection. A single-block estimate does not establish the event's spatial or temporal loading of support. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Constrain velocity using available images, block mass and landing evidence. If demand inferred only from block size misses the squared effect of velocity, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

units.anchor: 讓壓行程與吸能積分~Yielding stroke and energy integration
units.title: 讓壓行程與吸能積分~Yielding stroke and energy integration
units.mechanism: 讓壓構件透過受控變形吸收功，能量是力對實際行程的積分。高峰值力不一定有足夠行程，低剛度也不等於穩定吸能；必須看完整載入曲線及卸載後損傷，並區分元件試驗邊界與安裝系統邊界。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以校正荷重與相對位移積分，檢查行程末端反力變化；若出現構件行程用盡後突然變硬，將高反力傳到連接與岩體，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Yielding components absorb work through controlled displacement, integrating force over actual stroke. A high peak may lack travel, and low stiffness does not establish stable absorption. Review the full loading curve and damage while distinguishing component-test restraint from the installed support system. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Integrate calibrated force against relative displacement and inspect end-of-stroke response. If a component hardens abruptly when stroke is exhausted and overloads connections and rock, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 岩栓板網與共同變形~Bolt-plate-mesh deformation compatibility
units.title: 岩栓板網與共同變形~Bolt-plate-mesh deformation compatibility
units.mechanism: 吸能岩栓需要托盤與表面網把岩塊作用傳給它，任一連接先失效都會中斷路徑。各元件可能有不同位移和載入速率，不能只把產品額定能量相加；系統驗證必須確認網的變形、板的穿破和岩栓行程能相容。 判別這個機制時，應觀察同步量測網、托盤及岩栓相對位移和破壞順序；若出現托盤先穿破網面使岩栓未動員，名義吸能能力無法使用，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~An energy-absorbing bolt needs plates and mesh to deliver rock actions; premature connection failure interrupts that path. Components undergo different displacements and rates, preventing simple addition of product energy ratings. Verify compatible mesh deformation, plate punching and bolt travel as a system. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Measure mesh, plate and bolt relative movements and failure order simultaneously. If a plate punches through mesh before the bolt engages and its nominal energy capacity is unavailable, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 動態載入速率與試驗邊界~Dynamic rate and test boundaries
units.title: 動態載入速率與試驗邊界~Dynamic rate and test boundaries
units.mechanism: 動態事件的慣性和載入速率與慢速拉拔不同，錨固界面及金屬變形也可能隨速率改變。落錘試驗能量包含設備和試件的共同反應，不能只依落高推定材料實際吸收量；應量測反彈、裝置變形與力位移歷程。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將輸入能量與反彈、裝置變形及試件積分功作收支；若出現把設備吸收的能量算給岩栓，會高估元件動態表現，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Inertia and loading rate differ from slow pull tests and may change anchorage and metal response. A drop test contains both apparatus and specimen behaviour, so drop height alone does not establish absorbed material energy. Measure rebound, fixture deformation and force-displacement history. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Balance input energy against rebound, fixture deformation and integrated specimen work. If energy absorbed by the fixture is credited to the bolt and overstates dynamic performance, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 微震到時與位置不確定度~Microseismic arrivals and location uncertainty
units.title: 微震到時與位置不確定度~Microseismic arrivals and location uncertainty
units.mechanism: 微震定位使用多站到時差與波速模型，單站訊號不能唯一決定位置。岩層非均質、耦合品質和時鐘偏差會移動估計震源；到時殘差小也可能只是錯誤波速模型被擬合，必須用可驗證參考事件檢查定位誤差。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以已知參考位置事件檢查各站時鐘、耦合及定位殘差；若出現時間偏差被當成震源移動，使風險區域被錯誤定位，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Location uses multistation arrival differences and a velocity model; one station cannot uniquely locate a source. Heterogeneity, coupling and clocks shift estimates. Small residuals may merely fit an incorrect velocity model, requiring reference events with independently constrained positions to assess error. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check station clocks, coupling and location residuals against independently known reference events. If timing bias appears as source migration and mislocates the area of concern, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：pathDifference=v*dt=5000 m/s*0.002 s=10 m, not a unique source position。靜態強度、動態吸能及事件預警是不同證據，不可互相替代。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: pathDifference=v*dt=5000 m/s*0.002 s=10 m, not a unique source position. Static strength, dynamic energy absorption and event warning are distinct evidence and are not interchangeable. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.
units.verify: 以已知參考位置事件檢查各站時鐘、耦合及定位殘差。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「時間偏差被當成震源移動，使風險區域被錯誤定位」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。~Check station clocks, coupling and location residuals against independently known reference events. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Timing bias appears as source migration and mislocates the area of concern. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.
units.failure: 時間偏差被當成震源移動，使風險區域被錯誤定位。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到以已知參考位置事件檢查各站時鐘、耦合及定位殘差，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。~Timing bias appears as source migration and mislocates the area of concern. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check station clocks, coupling and location residuals against independently known reference events to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.
units.misconception: 單支感測器收到訊號就能唯一定位岩爆位置~One sensor receiving a signal uniquely locates a rockburst
units.practice: 將以已知參考位置事件檢查各站時鐘、耦合及定位殘差列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現時間偏差被當成震源移動，使風險區域被錯誤定位，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。~Apply the following check at handover: Check station clocks, coupling and location residuals against independently known reference events. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If timing bias appears as source migration and mislocates the area of concern, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

units.anchor: 串聯力鏈與容量區分~Serial force paths and capacity distinctions
units.title: 串聯力鏈與容量區分~Serial force paths and capacity distinctions
units.mechanism: 理想同軸串聯元件承受相同靜態拉力，因此最小力容量限制該理想力鏈。動態吸能卻是每一元件力位移積分，不存在一般性的最小能量法則；同一系統可能因連接位移限制而無法動員某元件的試驗吸能。 判別這個機制時，應觀察逐段核對傳力方向、靜態容量及各元件可用位移；若出現以最小額定能量代替系統動態分析，忽略不同元件行程，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Ideal collinear serial components carry the same static force, making the smallest force capacity a limit for that ideal chain. Dynamic energy depends on each force-displacement integral, without a general minimum-energy rule. Connection travel may prevent engagement of a component's tested absorption capacity. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Audit force directions, static limits and available displacement for each component. If using minimum rated energy as system capacity ignores differing component travel, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：staticForceCeiling=min(300,180,250) kN=180 kN; not a dynamic-energy prediction。靜態強度、動態吸能及事件預警是不同證據，不可互相替代。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: staticForceCeiling=min(300,180,250) kN=180 kN; not a dynamic-energy prediction. Static strength, dynamic energy absorption and event warning are distinct evidence and are not interchangeable. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If using minimum rated energy as system capacity ignores differing component travel, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

units.anchor: 事件計數與偵測完整度~Event counts and detection completeness
units.title: 事件計數與偵測完整度~Event counts and detection completeness
units.mechanism: 事件數增加可能反映真實活動，也可能是感測器靈敏度、噪音或網路覆蓋改變。比較前後資料須先固定可偵測尺度與品質篩選，否則更換設備後會產生假趨勢；計數、位置和能量估計應一起判讀，不能由單一門檻自動判定安全。 判別這個機制時，應觀察對照感測器在線率、噪音水準及同尺度事件分布；若出現感測器離線造成事件變少，被誤認為岩體活動降低，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~More detected events may reflect activity or changed sensitivity, noise and coverage. Fix detection completeness and quality filtering before comparison, otherwise equipment changes create artificial trends. Interpret count, location and energy estimates together rather than declaring safety from a single threshold. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare sensor availability, noise and events within a consistent detectable range. If offline sensors reduce event counts and falsely suggest quieter rock behaviour, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：observedRate=events/time=24 events/6 h=4 events/h。靜態強度、動態吸能及事件預警是不同證據，不可互相替代。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: observedRate=events/time=24 events/6 h=4 events/h. units.anchor: 監測融合與決策證據~Monitoring integration and decision evidence
units.title: 監測融合與決策證據~Monitoring integration and decision evidence
units.mechanism: 聲學訊號、收斂、岩片剝落及應力估計各觀察不同物理量，彼此不一致時需要診斷而非多數決。預警模型的誤報和漏報都與資料族群有關，不能用訓練準確率代替現地驗證；責任人必須知道哪些通道失效或尚未校核。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將警報逐件與觀察結果及資料缺口對照並保留未確認事件；若出現只統計已確認警報而忽略漏報，使預警可靠性被高估，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Acoustic signals, convergence, spalling and stress estimates measure different phenomena; disagreement needs diagnosis rather than majority voting. False alarms and misses depend on the data population, so training accuracy is not field validation. Decision owners need visibility of failed or unverified channels. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare each alert with observations and data gaps while retaining unconfirmed events. If counting confirmed alerts but ignoring misses overstates warning reliability, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 事件後剩餘行程與復核~Post-event remaining stroke and requalification
units.title: 事件後剩餘行程與復核~Post-event remaining stroke and requalification
units.mechanism: 事件後外觀完整不代表元件仍保有原容量，讓壓行程、錨固損傷和接頭變形都可能已消耗。只有經校準且仍符合假設的恆力元件，才能用剩餘行程乘力估剩餘功；不能直接從原額定能量扣掉估計事件能量來宣稱剩餘安全。 判別這個機制時，應觀察檢查讓壓剩餘行程、錨固及接頭損傷並由負責技師重核；若出現元件已耗盡行程卻沿用原額定容量，後續事件突然脆斷，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~An intact appearance does not preserve original capacity after stroke consumption, anchor damage or connection deformation. Remaining force times travel applies only to a calibrated constant-force element still meeting its assumptions. Subtracting estimated event energy from an original rating does not establish residual safety. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Inspect remaining stroke, anchorage and connection damage for engineer-led requalification. If an exhausted component retains its original rating on paper and fails abruptly in the next event, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

example: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查彈性能與釋放比例：u=sigma^2/(2E)=(100 MPa)^2/(2*50000 MPa)=0.10 MPa=100 kJ/m3；再獨立檢查拋出物動能與速度：Ek=0.5*m*v^2=0.5*100 kg*(5 m/s)^2=1250 J=1.25 kJ。線彈性應力由 100 增為 110 MPa、模數仍為 50 GPa，能量密度由 100 增為 121 kJ/m3；可釋放比例未知，不能全部當成拋石動能。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為靜態強度、動態吸能及事件預警是不同證據，不可互相替代。 將對照感測器在線率、噪音水準及同尺度事件分布作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。~All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Elastic energy and releasable fraction: u=sigma^2/(2E)=(100 MPa)^2/(2*50000 MPa)=0.10 MPa=100 kJ/m3. Independently check Ejected-rock energy and velocity: Ek=0.5*m*v^2=0.5*100 kg*(5 m/s)^2=1250 J=1.25 kJ. At a fixed 50 GPa modulus, stress rising from 100 to 110 MPa increases elastic energy density from 100 to 121 kJ/m3; an unknown releasable fraction prevents treating all of it as ejection energy. The two results are not a complete design because static strength, dynamic energy absorption and event warning are distinct evidence and are not interchangeable. Use compare sensor availability, noise and events within a consistent detectable range as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
history: 本課討論的用能量、變形與監測不確定度辨識岩爆支護需求，反映地下工程由單一構件強度走向地層、施工時序與維護共同驗證的發展。靜態強度、動態吸能及事件預警是不同證據，不可互相替代。 1992 年 CEDD 岩洞指南初版、2009 年 FHWA 隧道土木手冊及 2018 年岩洞指南第二版提供公開閱讀脈絡。哥達與英法海底隧道僅作地質及地下水邊界的比較，本課不主張取得其專有圖說或現場數據，只重建公開原理。~The focus on assess rockburst support using energy, deformation and monitoring uncertainty reflects the development from isolated member strength toward combined ground, sequence and maintenance verification. Static strength, dynamic energy absorption and event warning are distinct evidence and are not interchangeable. The 1992 first CEDD cavern guide, 2009 FHWA civil tunnel manual and 2018 second cavern-guide edition provide public context. Gotthard and the Channel Tunnel are comparisons of geological and groundwater boundaries only. This course claims no proprietary drawings or field data and reconstructs public principles.
